admission_steps:
University Online MBA Admission Process

The step by step Mizoram University online MBA admission process is mentioned below:

  1. Visit the official website of Mizoram University Online and register yourself.

  2. Fill in your personal information and verify your email address.

  3. Check eligibility and fill out the Mirozam online MBA admission form.

  4. Pay the application fee and submit the application form.

placement_content:
To offer placement assistance to students enrolled in an online MBA at Mizoram University Online, the institution established its Career Counselling and Placement Cell in 2012. The placement support includes a career counselling cell, a placement cell, and an equal opportunities scheme.

Some of the major recruiters of the Mizoram University Online MBA are HCL, Infosys, Powergrid Corporation of India, ICICI Bank, Accenture, etc.
syllabus_content:
The Miroram University online MBA syllabus follows a semester plan under which the initial year has core subjects, and the term-end year includes all the specialization-oriented subjects. The syllabus is taught by highly experiential faculty members and instructors through live sessions, assignments, projects, real-world case studies, and videos.

The detailed course syllabus for the Mizoram University online MBA in marketing management is mentioned in the table below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Business and Professional Skills
  • Business Environment
  • Managerial Economics
  • Marketing and e-CRM
  • Financial and Investment Analysis

Semester II

  • E- Banking and Financial Services
  • Design and Communications
  • Marketing Information System
  • Business Management
  • Market Research and Analytics

Year II

Semester III

  • Strategic Management
  • Data Analytics
  • Consumer Behavior
  • Web Development and Design Tools
  • Lead Generation and e-Marketing

Semester IV

  • Entrepreneurship in Age
  • Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
  • Media Laws and Compliance
  • Project Work
  • Seminar and Viva Voce
